flagged: F001: Origin is the left spigot end. The .250 dimension locates the groove center from the main-body shoulder; .062 CENT. places the groove-bottom boundaries symmetrically about that center. Both flanks are the indicated 30° TYP. The numerical coefficients 0.5773502691896258 and 1.7320508075688772 are tan(30°) and cot(30°), respectively, derived from the printed D008 and D009 angles, not independent dimensions. The .094 dimension is the axial lead-in length. Nominal diameters are modeled; the MAX shoulder blend is deferred separately.

F002: A #10-32 UNF thread (D012 nominal major diameter) conventionally uses a #21 drill, diameter .159 inch, from the Unified thread tap-drill chart. Crossed centerlines establish the hole at the part axis. D013 specifies the tapped length only: this feature represents that guaranteed threaded envelope with a flat bottom, not an inferred extra drilling depth or drill point. No thread fit class is assumed.

F003: The .159 diameter is the standard #21 tap drill for #10-32 UNF. D013 is expressly tapped depth, not a separately stated drill depth; no additional drill travel is invented. DEFAULT D5: drill depth = printed thread depth + 5 pitches (literal 5 / 32 is 5 thread pitches)
F004: DEFAULT D1: max-only radius built at the max value
